description: Audits a single Solidity file (code, required; optional contractName) across 24 SWC/DeFi rules using a 4-gate filter that excludes dust rounding and trusted-admin paths. Read-only and never broadcasts transactions: optionally supply deployed contractAddress, chainId (default 8453), and ownerTreasury to check live TVL via RPC and generate unsigned EIP-5792/EOA Safe-Harbor rescue calldata (90%-95% to ownerTreasury). Set tier to FULL ($0.85 USDC, default) for findings or ESSENTIAL ($0.35 USDC) for score and counts; unpaid calls return isError: true, and CRITICAL/HIGH patches remain sealed under Anti-Bypass until 0.15% SLA or 5%-10% rescue settlement. Use for single contracts; use ingravity_generateMultiContractProtocolDossier for multi-file protocols.

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID used only when contractAddress is supplied for live TVL verification (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 10 Optimism, 137 Polygon, 1 Ethereum; unknown falls back to 8453).

code.description: Raw Solidity (.sol) smart contract source code to audit across 24 SWC/DeFi rules (non-empty string required).

contractAddress.description: Optional deployed EVM contract address (0x...) on chainId to verify live TVL via RPC and generate unsigned Safe-Harbor rescue calldata.

contractName.description: Optional contract identifier or filename echoed in the report.

ownerTreasury.description: Optional protocol owner/multisig recipient (0x...) designated to receive 90%-95% of rescued capital in generated unsigned calldata.

tier.description: Billing & output depth: FULL ($0.85 USDC) includes findings and Safe-Harbor calldata (subject to Anti-Bypass sealing on CRITICAL/HIGH until proportional settlement); ESSENTIAL ($0.35 USDC) returns score, grade, status, and severity counts only.

name: ingravity_auditSolidityContract

capitalSalvageAndSafeHarbor.description: Unsigned Safe-Harbor rescue plan or optional pre-deploy circuit-breaker snippet (FULL tier only).

findings.description: Per-finding details with line coordinates and fix guidance (FULL tier only; CRITICAL/HIGH coordinates sealed until proportional settlement when applicable).

proportionalRescueCommissionPolicy.description: 0.15% Pre-Flight SLA and 5%-10% Safe-Harbor policy metadata (FULL tier only).

savedCapitalEstimateUsd.description: Estimated capital at risk or prevented exploit range.

settled.description: Whether x402 USDC payment settled cleanly.

verifiedOnChainTvlUsd.description: Live on-chain TVL verified via RPC when contractAddress is supplied (0 otherwise).

title: 24-Vector Solidity Contract Auditor
